title: StimFlow: Synthesizing Brain Activity from Images via Stimulus-conditioned Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.15341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The inherent variability of fMRI responses across trials encourages a generative view of the stimulus-to-response mapping. Prior generative encoders often operate in compressed latent spaces and condition predominantly on semantic features, which provide limited low-level cues for early visual cortex. We propose StimFlow, which synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space using conditional flow matching with a linear path. This design aligns training and inference distributions, enabling competitive performance with a single sample and reducing reliance on averaging. To match the visual hierarchy, StimFlow combines structural DINOv2 features with semantic CLIP features, which prove complementary along the cortical processing stream. With a single sample, StimFlow achieves a per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching baselines that average five draws. Generation in voxel space allows direct ROI analysis and concept localization

translated_title: StimFlow：通过刺激条件流匹配从图像合成大脑活动
translated_abstract: 摘要：fMRI响应在多次试验中固有的变异性促使人们以生成式视角看待从刺激到响应的映射。现有的生成式编码器通常在压缩的潜在空间中运行，并且主要以语义特征为条件，这对早期视觉皮层提供的低级线索有限。我们提出StimFlow，它使用带线性路径的条件流匹配直接在原生体素空间中合成fMRI。这种设计使训练和推理分布保持一致，仅需单次采样即可获得有竞争力的性能，并减少了对多次平均的依赖。为了匹配视觉层级，StimFlow将结构性DINOv2特征与语义性CLIP特征相结合，两者在皮层加工流上被证明是互补的。仅需单次采样，StimFlow即可达到每体素0.371的皮尔逊相关系数，与需要平均五次采样的基线方法相当。在体素空间中的生成支持直接进行ROI（感兴趣区域）分析和概念定位。
tldr: StimFlow利用条件流匹配直接在原生体素空间合成fMRI，通过结合结构性DINOv2特征与语义性CLIP特征，仅用单次采样即达到每体素0.371的皮尔逊相关系数，匹配需五次采样平均的基线方法，并支持直接ROI分析与概念定位。
en_tdlr: StimFlow synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space via conditional flow matching, combining structural DINOv2 and semantic CLIP features to achieve a single-sample per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching five-draw averaged baselines while enabling direct ROI analysis and concept localization.
